description.narrative: The proposed project will improve railway safety by installing advanced railway signaling equipment, communication, power supply, and tunnel monitoring systems on the E'Mei-Miyi section of the Chengdu-Kunming railway line in southwestern People's Republic of China (PRC). It will also enhance institutional capacity to manage railway safety.

description.narrative: A safe and efficient railway corridor between E?'Mei and Miyi developed

Corridor transportation capacity (number of trains dispatched daily) increased to 35 passenger train pairs between Chengdu and Kunming. Progress/Status: 12 pairs before landslide, not applicable after the landslide and during the COVID period, but 12 pairs HSR via Chongqing or Guiyang. Data Source: Annual Railway Statistical Bulletin issued by the National Railway Administration, People's Republic of China Actual value:

Travel time between Chengdu and Kunming is reduced by at least 50% as a result of reliable operations. Progress/Status: Around 18-20 hours through the Chengdu-Kunming corridor (K165 K113 etc), about 7 hours when New Chengdu-Kunming Railway line fully opened. but 5.5-6.5 hours through HSR via Guiyang new corridor (G2845 G2885 etc). Data Source: Project progress reports and project review missions Actual value:

Over 90% train punctuality is achieved by minimizing safety-related incidents. Progress/Status: 93% before the landslide in August 2019, not applicable after the landslide in and during the COVID period (only one pair of trains operating on the old Emei Miyi line and 3 pairs of trains on the new railway line in 2022). Data Source: Chengdu Railway Bureau's operational data Target value: ≥90 Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Institutional capacity for railway safety management enhanced Indicator: 100 staff in the executing agency and implementing agency are trained in railway safety and project implementation and management. Progress/Status: CKRC has conducted training to build capacity, using its own funds. In 2022, CKRC has organized 1) one specific training on preventing geological disasters and strengthening the safety management of working at height, 2) one specific flood prevention training and drills, and 3) one specific training on prevention of flood fire, and landslide collapse. More than 4,500 people from CKRC, contractors and supervisors were trained in these three safety trainings, including more than 500 female staff. Apart from these safety trainings and technical trainings, CR and CKRC provided intensive health and safety trainings on COVID-19 prevention since the breakout of the pandemic and considered the safety of the staff and contractor as the top priority of the work, which has ensured the timely implementation of the project and minimized the COVID impact. Data Source: Project progress reports Actual value:

Output: Railway signaling, communication, and power supply system developed Indicator: Signaling, communications and power supply system properly installed Progress/Status: Signaling, communication, and power supply system is operational at Mianning to Miyi section from 10 January 2022. Trial operations are currently being conducted and are expected to be completed in 2023.
